title: Heyo! I'm Dave and I create 'Text Based, Solo RPG, LLM Prompts'!
author: Ok-Head-5555
selftext:
So, I started creating text rpg's that use an LLM as the 'Game Master' about a year ago... And fell in love with the pure, sandbox-y, freedom of the medium. I'm normally terrible at self promotion and keeping up an "online/internet presence", but I've been trying hard to keep at it. 

If you have a minute to check out my latest work, (Maybe the rest of my catalog, if you enjoy it..  😉) I'd be sincerely grateful.

DUNE PIRATES - DESERT OF PLUNDER by Alone Together https://share.google/pEHNMF8gM0gPJ9ASP

 I'm also always open to constructive criticism as well, don't hesitate to hmu.

comments.author: re-skob
comments.body: pretty cool. awhile back I used to do an LLM tabletop RPG with my kids with the LLM voice chat and some dice. Never did formalize the rules though, just let it make it up as we went so it went to crazy places with no internal consistency

replies.author: Ok-Head-5555
replies.body: Thank ya! And it sounds like you were waaay ahead of me lol. Gaming with the kidos is dope tho, fr.

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body: I think it you spent a week world building, and created a structured set of documents, this would be pretty awesome.

replies.author: re-skob
replies.body: yeah, this was around the GPT 4o era where there was like a pretty small context window. I bet it could be made pretty great now

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body: Everyone wants to monetize it but I really think anyone could do it once we figure out an optimal system.  Like in the dark have a guide for the AI to create his own documents about NPC history fine-tuned and aggressively optimized.  Agentic AI is pretty good at knowing which documents to load when.  At least Claude coworker is .
